name: GroupRoomBlockManager
tagline: Hotel group blocks, pick-up, cut-off and attrition – the whole group sales desk in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete hotel group-sales module: hold room blocks night by night, update the pick-up from the PMS, watch cut-offs and release unsold rooms, see the attrition minimum and the money at risk, track rooming lists and deposits, earn comp rooms and keep group rooms per night under the hotel's ceiling – from tentative to actualised, with coordinator, sales and revenue roles. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Night-by-night block and pick-up patterns with +/− entry
Attrition minimum, shortfall and exposure; attrition charge at actualisation
Cut-off countdowns, release of unsold rooms and extensions with a 7-day rule
Group ceiling per night with Revenue manager approval
Rooming list due dates and deposits with one-click recording
Tentative → definite → released → in house → actualised; cancel with charge, lost, reinstate
Group inventory grid with on-pace, below-minimum, over-block and tentative cells
Roles: coordinator, sales manager, revenue manager
Undo, CSV export and printable pick-up report
Power Fx outputs and events (BlockSummaryText, SummaryJson)
